query:
SELECT 
  empresaSlug,
  COUNT(*) as total_lancamentos,
  SUM(cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5) as total_valor,
  MIN(data) as primeiro_dia,
  MAX(data) as ultimo_dia
FROM faturamentos
WHERE empresaSlug = 'mascote'
  AND data LIKE '2026-03-%'
GROUP BY empresaSlug;
